content.text: Found a bug: the "essential witness" computation used the wrong "others" union. Let me fix it.

arguments.command:
cd /app/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open('main.py').read()
old = """                    ok = True
                    for position in range(size):
                        others = union & ~masks[position]
                        essential = masks[position] & ~others
"""
new = """                    ok = True
                    for position in range(size):
                        others = 0
                        for other_position in range(size):
                            if other_position != position:
                                others |= masks[other_position]
                        essential = masks[position] & ~others
"""
assert old in src
src = src.replace(old, new)
open('main.py','w').write(src)
EOF
